item.title: Nadi Astrology in the Modern Era: How NadiVedas Is Bringing Structure, Clarity, and Continuity to an Ancient Knowledge System
item.description: For centuries, Nadi astrology has occupied a unique place in the spiritual history of South India. Unlike interpretive systems that rely on planetary positions or symbolic analysis, Nadi astrology is rooted in written records. These records, preserved on palm leaves, are traditionally attributed to ancient sages such as Shiva, Agastya, Vasishta, Kakabhushandi, Ravana, Kartikeya, and others.
